data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Bakht' meaning 'joy' or 'delight'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the joy and happiness found in following God's path. The name Bakhtia carries the meaning “Joy, Delight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bakhtia usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
